MIDDAY: the field mission landed (konjam thanni kudunga at dinner, she passed him the water), the melt line romba nallairukku fired cold and unscaffolded a second straight day, and M82 shipped — first narrated_drama, 21 first contacts, never-worked 30 -> 15 in one dose. EVENING (3 fires, espresso, eavesdrop-led): KU-FOR-LA IS CLOSED — 'canada-la irukken' instant, unaided, first ask, one day after missing that ending on paati's bag. OORU cold ('en ooru Toronto'). ORU MAASAM IRUPPOM instant BUT I nudged 'mind who's staying' — logged HINTED, honestly; the -om tail has still never had an unscaffolded test and it must come as an AMBUSH (knock or volley), never chat, because chat is where I keep scaffolding it. EAVESDROP: ran the vittudu tape live as mask-work. He took the MOOD off a line built over his head but read akka's closing 'nee solradhu puriyudhu' as confusion when it was SURRENDER — tone before propositional content is the shape of his ear. Catch 3/12, the starving axis. M83 SHIPPED: the gossip verandah vignette, -nu / -aam decoders, zero production demanded.\n\nTHE NIGHT'S REAL LESSON WAS ABOUT ME, NOT HIM. I closed with a field mission built on 'kaaram paravaayilla, pazhagippochu' and he rejected it on two grounds, both correct: (1) NO AUDIENCE — that is a CBE-table line and I aimed it at his own wife, who has watched him eat for ten years; the second instance of the contrived-mission complaint (first 07-15). (2) NO TEACH — the chunk was UNSEEN and I assigned it as a mission anyway, which is the ticket's never-cold-quiz rule broken by the back door. STANDING RULE FROM NOW ON: a mission line must be TAUGHT before it is assigned, and its audience must be a real person who would plausibly hear it. I then taught both words properly — paravaayilla (paravaai illa, 'no harm in it', from paravu = to spread; the shrug that both forgives and endures; backhanded as praise) and pazhagippochu (pazhagu = get used to AND get close to a person — the same verb for chilli and for family; + Kongu completive -poachu). No demand taken on either. REPLACEMENT MISSION, organic slot: deploy bare 'paravaayilla' the next time she apologises for anything at all. Collect tomorrow. HE ALSO SAID, at the open: 'why is this so many steps to say hello' — the protocol boot is visible and costs goodwill before any Tamil happens. STILL OPEN, never slotted: puriyala-for-reopen, now sharpened — he owns the word's shape, not its conversational job. Volley still frozen at 2/4 (KF-14). One ask per message is the house rule, his request.
